[LCRS.11.2] The language-level contract: any dialect can enable or
disable the `call` form (see
[LFCA]). Tiers that run
under frame-rate clocks, or whose rules can't absorb
response latency by design, run dialects that disable
`call`. Those rules reach external state via
`cached(...)` reads (the `let`-RHS expression form per
LGRA.9.8.2) against values a higher tier has written
through.
